title: Corner bakery
brief: A four-page illustrated website for a neighbourhood bakery, reviewed in a local preview.

answers.pages: Home, Menu, Story, Visit (hours and map link); light and dark themes.
answers.visual_style: Warm, hand-drawn, cream and cinnamon colours; avoid stock-photo look.
answers.media: Six illustrations: hero, three menu items, the shop front, a baker; no video.
